fields.description:
## Surface
AWS CloudWatch, us-east-1, acct 896586841071, host `rebar-gerrit` (rebar-autodeploy.service). Three correlated autodeploy alarms flapped 2026-08-29→30: `deploy_errors` ×11, `mcp_retire_cap` ×11, `review_interrupts_signal_unavailable` ×2. Deploy path is fail-safe (no outage) but releases were not landing cleanly and in-flight reviews may have been killed blind. Full RCA + evidence is in this ticket's RCA comment; this description is the fix plan.

## Root cause (proven — detail in the RCA comment)
**Mechanism 1 (deploy_errors ×11 + mcp-retire-cap ×11, one event).** `src/rebar/_mcp_health.py` sets uvicorn `timeout_graceful_shutdown=int(grace_seconds)` (line 743) with `grace_seconds` defaulting to the 1200s certified-op drain budget `DEFAULT_SHUTDOWN_GRACE_SECONDS` (line 51), and `make_sigterm_handler` sets `server.should_exit=True` **before** draining the in-flight gauge. Streamable-HTTP clients hold long-lived streams, so uvicorn's graceful shutdown waits the full 1200s for idle held-open streams even at 0 in-flight. With only two blue-green ports (8092/8093) a retiring container pins a port ~20 min → the next mcp deploy hits `port-exhausted` → `deploy_failed` + backoff. A landing burst (14 mcp + 142 bot redeploys in-window) drove it 11×.

**Mechanism 3 (signal-unavailable ×2).** In `infra/scripts/autodeploy.sh` the drain gate reads the bot `/health` `in_flight`; on an unreadable signal `bot_in_flight_reviews()` returns `-1` and the gate **fails open** — recreates the bot with no drain check, emitting `AUTODEPLOY_REVIEW_INTERRUPT signal-unavailable`. It cannot tell a bot that is **mid-redeploy** (unreachable only because it is being recreated / still starting) from one genuinely **wedged**; the blind recreate can kill the very startup it should wait for.

## Approach
Two independent, bounded, reversible fixes; each with its own RED→GREEN test.

**Fix 1 — decouple uvicorn graceful-shutdown from the certified-op grace (`_mcp_health.py`).**
- Add a short constant `DEFAULT_UVICORN_GRACEFUL_SECONDS` and use it for `uvicorn.Config(timeout_graceful_shutdown=...)`, decoupled from `grace_seconds` (which stays the op-drain budget); thread it as a defaulted `uvicorn_graceful_seconds` param on `run_http_with_grace` for testability.
- Reorder `make_sigterm_handler._on_sigterm` to drain the gauge FIRST (existing `drain_then_exit`, bounded by `grace_seconds`) and set `server.should_exit=True` only AFTER the gauge hits 0. A real in-flight op's streaming response then completes normally; once the gauge is 0, uvicorn's short backstop sweeps idle held-open streams in seconds instead of the full 1200s.
- Invariant preserved: >0 in-flight ⇒ full `grace_seconds` drain (never cut a real op short); 0 in-flight ⇒ fast drain. The op bound is enforced by the gauge poll, never uvicorn's short backstop.

**Fix 3 — distinguish "bot mid-redeploy" from "bot wedged" (`autodeploy.sh`).**
- Add best-effort `bot_unreachable_disposition()` that inspects the bot container's docker state/health → `redeploying` (status `restarting`/`created`/`removing`/`paused`, or docker health `starting`) vs `wedged` (running-but-unreachable, `unhealthy`, no container, or any inspect error → default `wedged`).
- In the drain gate's `inflight < 0` branch, when `redeploying`, DEFER (retry next tick) with a countable `AUTODEPLOY_DEFERRED bot-redeploying` marker, bounded by the existing `DEPLOY_DEFER_MAX` episode; on bound-exhaustion or `wedged`, fall through to the existing fail-open recreate + `signal-unavailable`. Maps the single unknown `-1` onto its own disposition instead of a blind fail-open (mirrors the 1c0d disposition-contract intent).
- Invariant preserved: a wedged/down bot still fails open and deploys (recovery path); the mid-redeploy defer is bounded so it cannot live-lock the gate; any docker error defaults to `wedged` (== pre-fix behavior).

## Scope
- `src/rebar/_mcp_health.py` — Fix 1 only. No change to `DEFAULT_SHUTDOWN_GRACE_SECONDS` (stays 1200), the gauge, or `drain_then_exit`.
- `infra/scripts/autodeploy.sh` — Fix 3 only. No change to the `inflight > 0` busy-defer path, the port pool, or `MCP_RELEASES_CAP`.
- Tests otherwise. **Deferred / out of scope:** raising `MCP_RELEASES_CAP` / expanding the port pool (Option 2); any nginx/compose capacity change; the separate concurrent disk bug e4f3.

## Testing
- Fix 1 (`tests/interfaces/facades/test_mcp_http_transport.py`): `make_sigterm_handler` does NOT set `should_exit` while the gauge is >0 and flips it only after the gauge drains to 0 (fast-drain + >0-in-flight preservation guard); `run_http_with_grace` configures `timeout_graceful_shutdown` to `DEFAULT_UVICORN_GRACEFUL_SECONDS`, decoupled from and less than the 1200s grace. Existing bound/exit tests still pass.
- Fix 3 (`tests/scripts/test_autodeploy_review_drain.py`, real-bash stub harness): mid-redeploy bot (unreachable `/health` + docker `starting`) is DEFERRED (no `compose build/up`, `AUTODEPLOY_DEFERRED bot-redeploying` emitted, no `signal-unavailable`, deployed-sha unchanged, rc 0); wedged bot (unreachable + docker `running`) still fails open (`compose build` runs, `signal-unavailable` counted); the mid-redeploy defer is bounded (pre-aged episode past `DEPLOY_DEFER_MAX` falls through to fail-open).
- `make lint` + `make typecheck` + the two targeted test modules; mutation check with teeth on the changed logic.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] A retiring MCP container with 0 in-flight certified ops shuts down within the short `DEFAULT_UVICORN_GRACEFUL_SECONDS` backstop (not the 1200s op grace), proven by a test asserting `timeout_graceful_shutdown == DEFAULT_UVICORN_GRACEFUL_SECONDS` and `< DEFAULT_SHUTDOWN_GRACE_SECONDS`.
- [ ] A retiring MCP container with >0 in-flight certified ops still receives the full `grace_seconds` drain and is never cut short, proven by a test asserting `should_exit` stays False until the gauge reaches 0.
- [ ] An unreadable `/health` caused by a mid-redeploy bot yields a DEFER with a countable `AUTODEPLOY_DEFERRED bot-redeploying` marker and no `compose build/up`, asserted by the bash harness.
- [ ] A genuinely wedged/down bot (or an exhausted mid-redeploy defer bound) still fails open, runs `compose build`, and emits the countable `AUTODEPLOY_REVIEW_INTERRUPT signal-unavailable` marker, asserted by the bash harness.
- [ ] No capacity change is made: `MCP_RELEASES_CAP` and the blue-green port set are unchanged; both fixes are in-process/host-local with no CI-provider dependency.
- [ ] `make lint`, `make typecheck`, and the two targeted test modules pass; each mechanism has an independent RED→GREEN test.
